summary: Tested the 5% short-stay surcharge (stays under 7 nights) and the manual total-amount edit for rentals, end to end. Backend pytest: 8/8 passed. Quote for 1, 3 and 6 nights adds +5%; quote for 7 and 10 nights has no surcharge. A pre-reservation is saved with montoEstimado=78750 for 3 nights at $25,000/night. PATCH /monto persists the new value, and a later PATCH /huesped does not overwrite it. PATCH /monto returns 404 for an unknown id and 422 for a bad body. UI (Playwright, real clicks): the rt-shortstay-notice is always visible and readable (yellow #E8E07A on a translucent yellow chip over a dark panel). Selecting 2-5 Nov 2026 (3 nights) shows rt-quote-recargo '+$ 3.750' and rt-total '$ 78.750'. Selecting 2-9 Nov (7 nights) shows no surcharge line and '$ 175.000'. Submitting the public pre-reservation (3 nights, 16-19 Nov) through the conditions modal worked, and the backend stored 78750. In the internal panel (logged in as qa_varela) the 'Editar datos' modal pre-fills rt-edit-monto with 78750. Changing it to 75000, along with name, locality, guests, deposit 40000 and cleaning 12000, and saving closed the modal. The row showed $ 75.000 right away and after reloading the page. Reopening the modal showed all edited values kept. Stale-screenshot problem: NOT reproduced; screenshots updated correctly after calendar clicks. Test reservation cancelled and deleted (404 confirmed).

minor.issue: No validation on MontoBody: negative or zero values are accepted (add Field(ge=0) or gt=0).

Editing the amount after a reservation is confirmed does not recalculate the commission already generated or the 30% deposit (seña) payment link, which were based on the old montoEstimado. This may be intended, but it is worth noting for confirmed reservations.
_quote() now also adds the 5% to internal/manual bookings when no amount is given. This is a side effect beyond the public pre-reservation; check that it is wanted.

ui_bugs.issue: guardar() sends Number(monto) || 0, so clearing the amount field and saving sets the reservation total to $0 with no warning. It should block an empty or 0 value, or skip the call.
updateMonto is always called, even when the amount did not change. Harmless now, but it adds an extra request and resets updatedAt.

action_items: EditarHuesped: stop an empty or 0 amount from overwriting montoEstimado with 0
Optional: add ge=0 validation to MontoBody
Optional: decide whether editing the amount on a confirmed reservation should update the commission and the seña link
critical_code_review_comments: The surcharge line in the price breakdown is calculated as total - base*(1-disc) on the frontend; it works, but the backend could return a recargoMonto field so both sides use the same number.
The rentals routes still have no auth dependency on internal endpoints such as PATCH /monto and DELETE (this was already the case before this change).
